title: FHA down payment - federal basics
facts: For standard FHA purchase financing, the minimum required investment can be as low as 3.5% for borrowers who meet applicable FHA credit requirements.
A 10% minimum investment can apply in certain lower-credit-score circumstances under FHA rules.
A lender may impose lawful underwriting requirements beyond the basic FHA program minimums.
Down-payment assistance and permitted sources of funds have separate FHA rules.
